items.title: AI Tool That Hacked Korean Banks Was Used in Japan, GMO Says
items.title_ko: AI Tool That Hacked Korean Banks Was Used in Japan, GMO Says
items.summary_ko: The hackers who recently infiltrated some of Japan’s biggest companies used an AI tool developed in China and linked to a rash of breaches at South Korean banks last month, according to a Tokyo-based internet security firm.

items.title: US to Bar China’s DeepSeek From Federal Agency Systems
items.title_ko: US to Bar China’s DeepSeek From Federal Agency Systems
items.summary_ko: The Trump administration barred civilian US government agencies from using products or services from Chinese artificial intelligence startup DeepSeek, citing a potential threat to national security from the company’s operations in China. Bloomberg's Annabelle Droulers explains.

items.title: SoftBank Credit Risk Hits 4-Year High on AI Funding Strain
items.title_ko: SoftBank Credit Risk Hits 4-Year High on AI Funding Strain
items.summary_ko: SoftBank Group Corp.’s credit risk, as measured by its credit-default swaps, has risen to the highest level in nearly four years as concerns grow over AI-related funding and a potential large acquisition.

items.summary_ko: Debt, AI and Ukraine dominated the conversation at the IMF-World Bank meetings in Bangkok, while China, the focus in 2018, slipped into the background.

items.title: Z.AI Founders Worked on Research Funded by China Institute UK Tied to Spies
items.title_ko: Z.AI Founders Worked on Research Funded by China Institute UK Tied to Spies
items.summary_ko: Four founders of one of China’s most promising artificial intelligence companies, Z.AI Co., worked on research in a joint project with a technology institute that the UK government accused of having “very strong ties” to China’s main spy agency, according to publicly available research papers from China and an “espionage alert” from the UK.

items.title_ko: Tenstorrent CEO on New Funding Round, AI Progress
